Landlords · in French

Rental property manager

For private landlords in France with long-term leases, furnished or not: rent due and paid month by month with late payments and arrears computed, rent receipts and three-step reminders to copy or print (nothing is sent), the annual rent review using the French rent reference index (IRL) that you enter, the yearly service-charge adjustment, gross and net yield before tax, and a yearly summary to help prepare your tax return (no tax calculation). Minimal tenant data.
